# 1mb

> Things to use, read and build with, each shipped end to end. All the hats. One head.

## use

- [sift](https://1mb.dev/work/sift/): Hacker News discussions picked by a scoring script with no editor: up to 12 threads, several runs a day, one per domain. No account, no archive.
- [firsthour](https://1mb.dev/work/firsthour/): Remote jobs from the Hacker News "Who is hiring?" thread and the job boards of companies posting there, listed by age. Last seven days, no account.
- [drift](https://1mb.dev/work/drift/): Always-on mood radio: focus music, ambient, lo-fi, funk and more, by mood or by album, with lyrics where a track has them. No account, no cookies.
- [geetanjali](https://1mb.dev/work/geetanjali/): Bhagavad Gita consultations for hard decisions: get options with tradeoffs and cited verses. Also 701 verses in Sanskrit, Hindi and English. No account.
- [cleartalk](https://1mb.dev/work/cleartalk/): Prep for hard conversations, at work or otherwise: profile someone's communication style, pick a situation, read a coaching card. Stays in the browser.
- [gist](https://1mb.dev/work/gist/): An app spec generator for AI coding assistants: describe an app idea, answer a few questions, download a markdown spec to start from. No account.
- [aipolicy](https://1mb.dev/work/aipolicy/): An AI policy generator for a repository: pick a preset, set the rules for contributors, download AI_POLICY.md, AGENTS.md and more. No install, no sign-up.

## read

- [log](https://1mb.dev/work/log/): A blog of short notes and essays on solo software work: shipping, maintenance, dependencies. Markdown in git, one Go binary, no database.
- [playbook](https://1mb.dev/work/playbook/): A short book of engineering principles for software teams: collaboration, design rules, code review, adoption. Five chapters, about thirty minutes.
- [ekam](https://1mb.dev/work/ekam/): Twelve essays on Advaita Vedanta and software engineering: debugging, state, abstraction, failure. Each says where its mapping stops.
- [nivomoney](https://1mb.dev/work/nivomoney/): retired. Neobank demo source: Go microservices, a double-entry ledger in Postgres, React apps, ADRs. Synthetic data, no real money.

## build with

- [markgo](https://1mb.dev/work/markgo/): A flat-file Go blog engine: markdown files in a directory, a web compose form, one binary with embedded assets. No database, no build step.
- [natcheck](https://1mb.dev/work/natcheck/): A NAT type check for WebRTC and P2P: one command forecasts whether direct connections will work from this network or TURN is needed. Go CLI, MIT.
- [ledgerq](https://1mb.dev/work/ledgerq/): An embedded Go message queue: a persistent, disk-backed log in a directory. No broker, one process, one read position, zero dependencies.
- [goflow](https://1mb.dev/work/goflow/): A Go concurrency library: token and leaky bucket rate limiters, worker pools, cron scheduling, pipelines and streams with backpressure. Needs Go 1.26. MIT.
- [shim](https://1mb.dev/work/shim/): A local proxy that runs Claude Code on DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter or Ollama, logging its rewrites and measuring every request. One Go binary.
